name: AI Companion
description: Adds AI companions to Minecraft that play like real people: they chat naturally, build a lit house with chests, farm their own food, dig a proper mine and strip mine for ores by level, fight creepers and skeletons, and look after themselves. Works on its own, or with an LLM for conversation.
contributors: shasankp000 (original AI-Player mod this is based on)
